description:
One siilostomy.org product: photos, sizes, EUR amount, and the page to pay on.

    Args:
        handle: Slug from search_org_products for that same language.
        lang: it, pl, cs, sk, sv, da, nb, fi, nl, el, hu, ro, pt, ja.
        product_id: Numeric id, if the handle is unknown.

    The person pays on the returned url. This tool does not create an order.
name: get_org_product
